text:
Anya: Quick ping — PR ready for merge but need runtime + infra + security eyes. CI is green, small KMS key rotation + eviction tweak. planning to merge TOMORROW 09:00 PT unless objections. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/9241

Jamal: can you paste the exact KMS changes? is it just config? also does this change affect prefix cache eviction timing?

Anya: it's two lines in `config/kms.yaml` (key alias rotation window) and a 1-line change in `runtime/eviction_controller.go` — we adjust `evictionCooldown` from `120s` to `30s` for low-memory hosts. not touching cache semantics, just cooldown.

Kevin: friendly ping — runtime can take a look. i might be able to review tonight. is there a quick perf test i should run locally to smoke the eviction delta?

Anya: yes — run:
```
make smoke-test-docker
./bin/smoke --eviction-debug --target=small
```
should see `evictionCooldown=30s` in logs and no OOMs in 10m window.

Sara: FYI platform: if this goes in tomorrow morning we should reserve the 09:00-09:30 merge window and notify oncall for watch. @kevin if you plan to merge can you coordinate with @oncall?

Kevin: i can do the runtime review and coordinate with oncall. i'll also run the smoke-test. if green i'll give `LGTM` and tag security for KMS approval.

security-bot: Security checklist required: 1) confirm key alias rotation handled by KMS (yes/no). 2) add audit log link. Please add `security-approval` label to PR and attach IAM diff.

Jamal: quick Q — does the shorter eviction cooldown change autoscaler behavior? might cause more churn.

Anya: autoscaler unchanged; eviction triggers earlier but we only target hosts with `low-memory` taint. added an integration test in `tests/eviction/lowmem.sh`.

Kevin: smoke-test passed locally, no regressions in 20 runs. posting snippet:
```
[eviction] cooldown=30s traces=0/20
[allocator] stable
```

Kevin: LGTM from runtime side. tagging @security for approval and @sara for platform schedule.

Sara: acked. i've reserved 09:00 slot and notified infra ops. please add short runbook in PR desc (one-paragraph) for oncall.

Anya: added runbook + IAM snippet, added `security-approval` label. thanks all :thumbsup:

security-bot: Received label. Security team to review — expect response within 4 hours. If approved, add `security-lgtm` comment.

Jamal: thanks — i'll stand by to watch canary.

Anya: will merge after runtime + security signs. thanks everyone!
